column4: سر عظيم يفوق عقول البشر: هو سعي مخلصنا: الذي أتى وصار ابن بشر.

column12: A great mystery, beyond all human minds, is the pursuit of our Savior, who came and became the Son of man.

column4: محب البشر الصالح الذي عال إسرائيل: أربعين سنة في البرية أتى وصار ابن بشر.

column12: The good Lover of mankind, who sustained Israel, forty days in the wilderness, came and became the Son of man.

column4: ولما أكمل التواضع بعد ثلاثين سنة من الزمان: اعتمد وصام أربعين يوماً وأربعين ليلة.

column12: We took from them this example, which You gave them, that we may do it at all times, until Your Second Coming.

column12: For we are Your people, and the sheep of Your flock, ignore our sins, as a good One and Lover of mankind.

column12: Make us worthy to be, of Your grace O Savior, in these days without sin, and in a pure fasting.

column12: Let us love one another, and be humble, for through love, we fulfill the commandments.

column12: The Law and the prophets, are love without hypocrisy, for through love, we can obtain forgiveness.

column12: Let the doors of the churches be open for us, and confirm us in the upright faith, that we may attain the faithful promise, of Your mouth which says.

column12: "Come unto Me, O blessed of My Father, and inherit the life, that endures forever."
